name: zabbix-ai-cli-mcp
description: Ask Zabbix what is broken and why an alert fired or never arrived. Read-only by default: the bundled server starts with writes switched off.

zabbix_url.title: Zabbix URL
zabbix_url.description: Base URL of your Zabbix frontend, e.g. https://zabbix.example.com

zabbix_token.title: Zabbix API token
zabbix_token.description: Zabbix API token (User settings > API tokens). Stored in the system credential store.
